user_query: I want to retrieve car case data from our database.

TaskList.description: Connect to the car dealership's database to initiate a data retrieval operation.
Query the database for car cases and fetch the relevant details: case number, title, type, status, description, create date, and update date.
Format the retrieved data into a structured format for easy interpretation and reporting.
Store or export the formatted case data to a specified file or system for future reference.
